periods.label: 协助一辉调整的雷切

status.current: helps Ikki prepare, observes the final, and has her entrusted school flag raised by him

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection-final opponent; responds to his request and pressures him seriously in a tuning match.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Friend who covers for her delayed arrival to the student council group.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Peer-level helper in Ikki's preparation gauntlet.

periods.summary: Toka delays joining the student council because Ikki asks her to help him prepare. In the training ring she exploits the weakness of Ikki's Edelweiss-derived movement by alternating Raio shots, then forces him into close-range swordplay with her Denkou-accelerated counters and threatens Raikiri. Ikki defeats her by using battlefield debris to jam Narukami's sheath, and Toka recognizes his broader battlefield intelligence. At the award ceremony, the Hagun flag she entrusted to Ikki is handed to him so he can raise it from the champion podium.

key_events.summary: Spars with Ikki and forces him to improvise against Denkou and Raikiri.
Her entrusted Hagun flag becomes the symbol Ikki raises as champion.

periods.time: Ikki's victory party at Ittousei after Seven Stars
periods.label: 迈向A级联盟的雷切

status.current: plans to train over summer and enter Japan's National League after graduation
status.condition: frustrated she never fought Moroboshi but motivated by Ikki and Stella's level

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Friendly rival; they discuss the anti-Hahakiboshi technique and promise to meet in higher leagues.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Junior whose victory pushes her to re-evaluate her own immaturity.
relationships.nango-torajiro: Teacher she plans to train under during summer.

periods.summary: Toka attends Ikki's victory party and discusses with Moroboshi the match they never had. She confirms that her electromagnetic sword technique Raikou was refined partly to counter Moroboshi's Hahakiboshi, and the two jokingly argue over who would have won. After seeing Ikki and Stella's final, Toka realizes she is still immature and plans to spend summer retraining under her master before entering the domestic league and aiming for the A-League.

key_events.summary: Discusses future professional paths with Moroboshi.
